verdict.rationale: The Gemini API video docs list video inputs and 'multi-turn conversational editing (e.g., element replacement or perspective changes)' (veo-docs-9), with multi-turn refinement via the Interactions API (veo-docs-8). That is a documented own capability for replacing elements in existing video. However, the same page points users to migrate to Gemini Omni Flash (veo-docs-7), so it is unclear whether this editing belongs to Veo or to the successor model. Nothing shows the rest of the frame stays intact; the closest hands-on report, about Whisk image-to-video, says it redraws the whole source rather than preserving it (veo-comm-19), though that is not video element editing. Missing for 10: clear attribution of element replacement to Veo itself, evidence of frame preservation outside the edited element, restyle-specific documentation, and hands-on corroboration.
